results.detail: two payments posted as journals and linked: at version 12 the position equals fixture 05 (interest paid 164.23, principal 0.00); the second journal corrected at 13: the position at 13 counts one payment (principal outstanding 10088.77, interest outstanding 75.46) and re-emits the rounding events; the position at 12 is unchanged

results.ref: AT-R28-09 (authorization: grants, partial view, revocation; never an existence leak)
results.detail: without a grant the position is NOT_FOUND (same as an unknown id) and declaring is NOT_POSTABLE; a view grant on one side shows the position with partial_view = true; terms need post rights on every household side; revoking the grants hides the loan again; a viewer cannot declare

a repeated idempotency key returns the same loan (one row) and a changed payload under it is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; a term batch with one invalid event writes nothing; INVALID_PRINCIPAL for 3 decimals in CAD; a link is versioned (position at the earlier ledger version counts 0 payments, after the link 1, after unlinking 0); a loan without terms is TERMS_UNVERIFIED with null figures, never zero

results.ref: AT-R28-CONS-01 (household_internal only from verified ownership facts); F-C2-07 enforcement points
results.detail: household_internal is true only when both sides are household accounts whose recorded ownership names the lender and the borrower; false for an external borrower and for a payable account owned by another party; the three loan tables carry their t_scope_flag triggers
